title: Successful user login with valid credentials
description: Verify that a user can successfully log in using valid username/email and password.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid username/email
Enter valid password
Click the login button
Check user is successfully authenticated and redirected to dashboard

title: Login failure with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login fails when invalid username/email or password is provided and error message is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter invalid username/email
Enter invalid password
Click the login button
Verify login failure and error notification is shown

title: User registration success
description: Validate new users can register successfully using a valid registration form.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page
Fill registration form with valid data
Submit registration form
Confirm new user is registered and redirected or informed correctly

title: Dashboard loads projects for authenticated user
description: Verify the dashboard displays a list of projects belonging to the logged-in user.

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to dashboard page
Verify projects list is displayed with correct project titles and statuses

title: Project detail page loads project and scene data asynchronously
description: Verify that upon loading the project detail page, project and scenes data load asynchronously with loading indicators visible.

steps.description: Navigate to a project detail page with valid projectId and sceneId in URL
Confirm loading spinner or status indicator is shown during data fetch
Verify project and scene data loaded successfully and displayed

title: Validate URL parameters projectId and sceneId parsing
description: Verify that URL parameters 'projectId' and 'sceneId' are correctly parsed on the project detail and scene editor pages.

steps.description: Navigate to project detail page with various valid and invalid projectId and sceneId URL parameters
Verify parameters are parsed correctly for valid data
Verify appropriate error or fallback UI is shown for invalid or missing parameters

title: Handle failure in loadSceneNodes API gracefully
description: Confirm that if nodeStore.loadSceneNodes API call fails, the UI shows appropriate error feedback and remains stable.

steps.description: Simulate failure of loadSceneNodes API while opening scene editor
Verify error message or UI indication is shown to user
Ensure application does not crash or freeze

title: Node selection and deselection updates state correctly
description: Verify that selecting and deselecting nodes in the scene editor updates the selection state accordingly.

steps.description: Open scene editor with multiple nodes present
Select a node by clicking it
Verify node is marked as selected in UI and state
Click outside any node or perform deselection action
Verify selection state is cleared in UI and state

title: Delete nodes with Delete and Backspace keys only when input not focused
description: Verify keyboard shortcuts Delete and Backspace delete selected nodes only when no input or text field is focused.

steps.description: Focus is not in any input or text field on scene editor
Select one or more nodes
Press Delete key
Verify selected node(s) are deleted
Focus on a text input field
Press Backspace key
Verify currently focused input is affected but nodes are not deleted

title: Undo node actions using Ctrl+Z keyboard shortcut
description: Test that Ctrl+Z keyboard shortcut correctly triggers undo functionality integrated with nodeStore history stack.

steps.description: Perform multiple node actions such as node deletion and repositioning
Press Ctrl+Z to undo last change
Verify last node action is reversed successfully
Press Ctrl+Z repeatedly to undo multiple actions
Verify node state reverts correctly for each undo operation

title: Auto-layout rearranges nodes without corrupting graph
description: Verify that the auto-layout feature arranges nodes logically and maintains graph integrity without corruption.

steps.description: Arrange nodes manually in a complex graph with overlaps
Click the auto-layout button to trigger layout rearrangement
Verify nodes repositioned to non-overlapping layout
Verify graph connectivity and relationships remain consistent

title: Real-time collaboration - socket connection established on scene editor mount
description: Validate collabStore.joinRoom initiates socket connection when the scene editor component is mounted.

steps.description: Open scene editor page
Verify socket connection is established to join collaboration room

title: Real-time collaboration - socket disconnects cleanly on scene editor unmount
description: Ensure collabStore.leaveRoom disconnects socket properly when scene editor is unmounted to prevent zombie connections.

steps.description: Open scene editor page and confirm socket connection is active
Navigate away from scene editor page or close it
Verify socket connection is terminated cleanly

title: Real-time updates reflect other users' cursors and state changes instantly
description: Verify that cursor positions and node state changes made by other users in the collaboration room are updated in real-time.

steps.description: Join collaboration room with two users in scene editor
User A moves cursor or modifies node state
User B sees cursor position and updates reflect instantly

title: Timeline clips recompute immediately on changes to confirmedVideos data
description: Verify that timelineClips are recalculated instantly when the underlying video clip data changes.

steps.description: Open timeline view
Update confirmedVideos data (e.g., add, remove, modify clips)
Verify timeline clips recompute instantaneously and display updated info

title: Total duration sums clip durations correctly and handles missing metadata gracefully
description: Confirm totalDuration calculation sums clip durations correctly and does not produce rendering errors when thumbnail or version info is missing.

steps.description: Open timeline view with clips including some missing thumbnail or version metadata
Verify totalDuration is accurately summed from clip durations
Verify UI renders without errors despite missing metadata

title: Auto-layout button maintains consistent position after drag-and-drop
description: Verify the auto-layout button stays in the correct UI position after performing drag-and-drop operations on the scene editor canvas.

steps.description: Open scene editor
Drag and drop nodes around the canvas
Check that the auto-layout button remains fixed in its designated UI location and visible

title: Responsive UI layout does not overlap or distort on screen resize
description: Verify that UI elements including canvas and panels adapt responsively to different screen sizes without overlap or distortion.

steps.description: Open any main page such as dashboard or scene editor
Resize browser window from large to smallest supported viewport
Verify no UI element overlaps another or distorts, and all content remains accessible

title: User can view their profile information correctly
description: Verify that the user profile page displays the correct user information fetched from backend.

steps.description: Navigate to user profile page after login
Verify user details such as name, email and other profile fields are displayed correctly

title: User can edit and save profile updates successfully
description: Verify that profile information can be edited and saved, and changes persist after reload.

steps.description: Navigate to profile edit page
Modify one or more profile fields
Save profile changes
Confirm save is successful and new data is reflected on profile page and after refresh

title: Robust asynchronous data loading using Promise.all
description: Validate that project and scene data APIs are requested and handled in parallel with Promise.all and results processed in order.

steps.description: Open project detail page triggering loadProject and loadScenes API calls
Verify both API calls are requested concurrently and resolved successfully in expected sequence
Verify UI updates only after all data is loaded

title: Logout and cleanup socket connection on page exit
description: Verify user logout triggers socket disconnection and cleans up collaboration resources to avoid zombie connections.

steps.description: Log in and join collaboration room
Logout or navigate away from scene editor
Verify socket is disconnected cleanly and resources freed
